candidate_ideas.statement: On a hyperelliptic curve every degree-four divisor with h^0 >= 2 is linearly equivalent either to g^1_2 + p + q, in which case the complete pencil has base points p, q and the induced map drops to degree two, or to 2 g^1_2, which is composed with the hyperelliptic map; hence every finite flat degree-four pencil on a hyperelliptic curve is hyperelliptic-composed, and a fibrewise balanced family has no hyperelliptic geometric fibres.

The hyperelliptic branch of the genus-six g^2_5 classification can be closed independently of the plane-quintic exclusion, so that base-point-freeness of L on the balanced locus does not require entering the plane-quintic case at all.

Density of the distinct-support open in each P^2 fibre survives the non-birational case: when phi_L : C -> P^2 has degree greater than one onto its image, a general line still avoids the finitely many branch values and the singularities of the image, so the pullback consists of six pairwise-distinct points rather than merely a reduced divisor.

The projective-bundle model, the S_6-torsor structure, the relative smoothness, and the codimension-four regular immersion extend from a reduced locally Noetherian scheme base to an algebraic stack base with a smooth atlas, via smooth-locality of Grauert local freeness with base change, preservation of reducedness under smooth pullback in characteristic zero, and descent of the canonical Abel-Jacobi/projective-bundle identification along the atlas.

The number of irreducible components of the ordered failure locus over each component of the unordered model is [S_6 : H] for H the geometric monodromy image of the finite etale torsor, given a normality hypothesis on the base of the cover.
The geometric monodromy of the ordered incidence realizes the full symmetric group S_6, in particular contains a transposition arising at an identified occurrence locus.

The constancy statement h^0(omega_C(-D)) = 3 on the whole balanced locus is equivalent to the exclusion of balanced fibres carrying a tetragonal pencil that factors through a degree-two map, and more generally the exclusion of non-primitive degree-four pencils through a positive-genus intermediate curve remains a separate geometric question from the hyperelliptic-composed exclusion.
The balanced base of the family is irreducible, so that the component correspondence for the incidence, its distinct-support open, and the ordered cover reduces to a single component.

The balanced ordered failure model admits a well-defined morphism to M_{6,6} that is quasi-finite, and its image has an identifiable closure and absolute codimension; equivalently the tetragonal pencil gamma is recoverable from the degree-six bundle L = W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1} via L ~= omega_C(-D), so that the generically five-to-one ambiguity of g^1_4's on a general genus-6 curve is resolved.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, 'CE line-bundle convention' and 'Degree calculation' bullets, together with the primary locator excerpt SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 (degree/Serre-duality calculation).
established_facts.statement: With the Casnati-Ekedahl convention W_f := (O_{P(E^vee)}(2) tensor gamma^*O(-f))|_C for a degree-four cover gamma: C -> P^1, one has deg(W_f|_C) = 2(2g-2+4*2) - 4f = 4g+12-4f; at g=6 this gives deg W_4 = 20 and deg W_5 = 16.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, primary locator excerpt SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, and adjudicated findings FND-0062, FND-0063, FND-0074.
established_facts.statement: For a degree-n divisor Gamma on a genus-g fibre, deg(omega_C tensor W_f|_C^vee(Gamma)) = 2g-2-(4g+12-4f)+n = 4f+n-2g-14; substituting g=6 gives n-10 for f=4 and n-6 for f=5, so at n=6 the f=4 component has degree -4 and the f=5 component has degree 0.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, 'Six-point failure locus' bullet and adjudicated findings FND-0062 and FND-0063.
established_facts.statement: On any smooth genus-6 degree-four cover with balanced relations bundle F = O(4) + O(5), the f=4 component of the evaluation obstruction bundle has negative degree, so H^0(omega_C tensor W_4^vee(Gamma)) = 0 identically and the entire obstruction is carried by the f=5 component; evaluation fails on a degree-six Gamma if and only if O_C(Gamma) is isomorphic to L := W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}, a degree-six line bundle.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated finding FND-0105 (records deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(2)|_C) = 2(2g-2+4*2) from SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 and the twist shift 4 deg A).
established_facts.statement: Under the weak relative-canonical normalization O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C ~= omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2) tensor gamma^*A, the degree bookkeeping deg(O_{P(E^vee)}(1)|_C) = 2g+6 = deg(omega_C tensor gamma^*O(2)) forces deg A = 0, hence A ~= O_{P^1} and W_5 ~= omega_C^2(-D), L ~= omega_C(-D), M := omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee ~= O_C(D), where O_C(D) = gamma^*O_{P^1}(1) has degree four.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated findings FND-0073 and FND-0103.
established_facts.statement: On every smooth genus-6 fibre of a balanced degree-four family, M := omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee has degree 4 and satisfies h^1(M) = h^0(omega_C tensor M^vee) = h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) >= 1, so M is always special; Clifford's theorem then gives h^0(M) <= deg(M)/2 + 1 = 3 with equality only for hyperelliptic C with M ~ 2 g^1_2. Consequently h^0(L) lies in {1,2,3,4} and never equals 5.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated finding FND-0125, verified in the model y^2 = f_14(x), z = x^2 (restriction H^0(Sym^2 E(-6)) -> H^0(6A) surjective onto the 7-dimensional space of degree-<=6 polynomials in x, kernel H^0(O(1))*(w^2 - z v^2) of dimension exactly 2).
established_facts.statement: If C is hyperelliptic of genus 6 and gamma has degree 4, then gamma = q o h factors through the hyperelliptic double cover, E = O(1) + O(4) + O(4), and the relations bundle is exactly F = O(2) + O(7); this is incompatible with the balanced splitting F = O(4) + O(5).

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated findings FND-0139 and FND-0142.
established_facts.statement: Under the balanced hypothesis together with the weak relative-canonical normalization, every geometric fibre satisfies h^0(O_C(D)) = 2, h^0(L) = 3 and h^1(L) = 2; the jump stratum with h^0(L) = 4 is empty, so the h^0 stratification of the relative degree-six linear system is constant on the balanced locus.

established_facts.evidence: Arithmetic receipt: deg L = deg W_5 - (2g-2) = 16 - 10 = 6; chi(L) = 6 - 6 + 1 = 1; Clifford bound deg(D)/2 + 1 = 4/2 + 1 = 3; cross-check deg(omega_C^2(-D)) = 2*10 - 4 = 16 = deg W_5 at g=6, f=5.
established_facts.statement: The two-step derivation of the fibre dimensions is mechanical: h^1(L) = h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1}) = h^0(O_C(D)) by Serre duality with L ~= omega_C(-D), and chi(L) = deg L - g + 1 = 6 - 6 + 1 = 1 gives h^0(L) = 1 + h^1(L); Clifford leaves h^0(O_C(D)) in {2,3} and the equality branch is the hyperelliptic-composed case excluded by the balanced splitting.

A base point p of L = omega_C(-D) on a genus-6 curve would make L(-p) a g^2_5, forcing the smooth plane quintic case, whose tetragonal pencil is projection from that base point and has unbalanced CE relations splitting; hence L is base-point-free on every fibre of the balanced locus.

On a balanced fibre satisfying the weak CE normalization, h^0(L) = 3 together with base-point-freeness yields a finite morphism phi_L : C -> P^2 with spanning image which, in characteristic zero, is separable onto its image; by Bertini a general line pulls back to six distinct points, so the reduced-support open of the closed Abel-Jacobi incidence is nonempty and dense in every fibre of the P^2-bundle.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated findings FND-0107 and FND-0047.
established_facts.statement: For a line bundle L of relative degree d on a smooth proper curve family C/B, the functor of relative effective divisors Gamma with O(Gamma) ~= L is represented by the Abel-Jacobi fibre Sym^d(C/B) x_{Pic^d_{C/B}} B, which is closed because the relative Picard scheme is separated; on smooth curves Hilb^d = Sym^d since every length-d subscheme is Cartier. This model is correct over all of B, whereas Proj(pi_*L) has correct fibres only over the open where h^0(L) is constant.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated findings FND-0064 and FND-0075.
established_facts.statement: The forgetful map from the relative ordered distinct configuration stack Conf_6(C/B) to the relative space of degree-six effective divisors is a finite etale S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open locus, and the deck action is free because a permutation fixing an ordered tuple of six pairwise-distinct points is the identity; with Q-coefficients S_6-invariants and S_6-coinvariants agree, so descent from the ordered to the unordered model is harmless rationally but is not available integrally or on the coarse space.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated finding FND-0141; relative-dimension receipt Conf_6(C/S) smooth of relative dimension 6 minus relative dimension 2 gives codimension 6 - 2 = 4.
established_facts.statement: Over a reduced locally Noetherian base carrying a balanced family with the normalization hypothesis, the evaluation-failure scheme inside Conf_6(C/S) is S-smooth of pure relative dimension two (via its identification with the S_6-torsor of orderings of the reduced-support open of P_S(pi_*L)), and the closed immersion into Conf_6(C/S) is a regular immersion of pure codimension four with locally free rank-four conormal and locally split conormal sequence; the lci conclusion follows from S-smoothness of both schemes, not from any excess of actual over determinantal expected codimension.

established_facts.evidence: Packet C66-001-v4, adjudicated findings FND-0097 and FND-0099.
established_facts.statement: In the filtered CE reduction 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0, the identity Fit_0(coker phi) = Fit_0(coker phi_5) holds without any global splitting hypothesis, provided one cites the degree vanishings: exactness of pi_* requires R^1 pi_* W_4 = 0, which at (g,n) = (6,6) holds because deg W_4 = 20 > 2g-2 = 10, and coker(phi_4) = 0 requires H^1(W_4(-Gamma)) = 0, i.e. degree 14 > 10, plus commutation of the cokernel with base change.

For the filtered balanced evaluation map at (g,n) = (6,6) with six pairwise-disjoint sections, every geometric fibre has rank(phi) in {11,12} and rank(phi_5) in {5,6}, because the cokernel is Serre-dual to H^0 of a degree-zero line bundle; consequently the deeper minor ideals satisfy I_11(phi) = I_5(phi_5) = O_B as ideal sheaves on any locally Noetherian base.

The universal determinantal identity Fit_0(coker(p_*L_univ -> p_*(L_univ|_{Gamma_P}))) = I_e on C x_S Pic^0(C/S) holds for all g >= 1 and n >= 1, since deg L_univ = 2g-2+n > 2g-2 forces R^1 p_* = 0 with h^0 = g+n-1, and the intrinsic derivative at e is the perfect Serre pairing H^1(O) x H^0(omega) -> H^1(omega); the (6,6)-specificity of the CE identification enters only through the degree-zero condition 2g-2-deg W_5+n = 0.

established_facts.evidence: Standard going-down for flat morphisms plus closedness and dimension preservation under finite morphisms; dimension receipt dim(V_alpha) = dim(S_alpha) + 2 from the P^2-bundle fibre dimension 2.
established_facts.statement: For a finite flat surjection, every irreducible component of the source dominates an irreducible component of the target and has the same dimension: going-down places the generic point of a source component over a generic point of the target, the finite image is closed and hence equals that component, and finite morphisms preserve dimension. Applied to the ordered S_6-cover of a dense open of a P^2-bundle over a base component S_alpha, this yields relative component dimension dim(S_alpha) + 2.

For a genus-6 curve admitting both a degree-2 map h and a degree-4 map gamma to P^1, Castelnuovo-Severi non-independence alone does not name the factorization; one must add that any common intermediate factor phi has degree dividing 2 and at least 2, hence phi = h up to automorphism of the target and gamma = q o h with deg q = 2.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Where h^0(L) jumps, pi_*L does not commute with base change and Proj(pi_*L) has the wrong fibres; the construction is valid only over the open locus of constant h^0. The base-independent model is the Abel-Jacobi incidence Sym^6(C/B) x_{Pic^6(C/B)} B, closed by separatedness of the relative Picard scheme, and it agrees with Proj(pi_*L) only over that open.
invalid_steps.statement: Identifying the relative degree-six linear system with Proj(pi_*L) over an arbitrary base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Fibrewise balancedness only supplies the relative Harder-Narasimhan filtration 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0. A global splitting is an extra hypothesis: its obstruction is the extension class in Ext^1_{P^1_B}(L_4, L_5), which lies in H^1(B, gamma'_*O(1)) and need not vanish over a general base, while the fibrewise Ext vanishes so no local obstruction is visible.
invalid_steps.statement: Deducing a global direct-sum splitting W ~= W_4 + W_5 from fibrewise balancedness F_s ~= O(4) + O(5).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Finiteness of Gamma gives only exactness of restriction to Gamma (the sequence is locally split, so it survives tensoring with O_Gamma) and exactness of pushforward along Gamma -> B. Surjectivity of pi_*W -> pi_*W_5 along the curve fibration is a separate vanishing statement R^1 pi_* W_4 = 0, which must be certified by a degree inequality deg W_4 > 2g-2 and rechecked whenever deg W_4 <= 2g-2.
invalid_steps.statement: Inferring exactness of pi_* on the filtration 0 -> W_4 -> W -> W_5 -> 0 from finiteness of Gamma over the base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Grauert's criterion requires the base to be reduced. Over a nonreduced base, constant dimensions of the cohomology of a perfect two-term complex on geometric fibres do not imply locally free cohomology; a separate scheme-theoretic constant-rank or lifting argument is required.
invalid_steps.statement: Concluding local freeness of pi_*L and R^1 pi_*L, and arbitrary base change, from constancy of the fibre dimensions on geometric points over an arbitrary base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Expected-codimension bookkeeping is neither necessary nor sufficient for regularity: a component of codimension below the determinantal expectation may still be locally cut out by a regular sequence of its actual codimension, and a nowhere-lci conclusion requires local ideal-depth or conormal calculations. The valid route is a closed immersion between schemes smooth over the base, whose codimension is the relative-dimension difference.
invalid_steps.statement: Deriving a local complete intersection or regular-immersion conclusion from a comparison between the actual codimension of a degeneracy locus and the generic determinantal expected codimension.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The balanced reduced-support model is only an open piece of the evaluation-failure locus; Gysin for (M_{6,6}, Z) requires a closed (stratified) embedding obtained after h^0 and splitting-type stratification. Openness of balancedness inside the tetragonal locus supplies neither closedness nor purity.
invalid_steps.statement: Treating the balanced reduced-support relative linear system as a closed pure-codimension-four subvariety of M_{6,6} and applying a Gysin morphism to the pair.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: M_{6,6} forgets the pencil gamma, and a general genus-6 curve carries five distinct g^1_4's, so the underlying forgetful map is generically five-to-one; injectivity requires recovering gamma from L, whose only standard route is L ~= omega_C(-D), returning the pencil as |omega_C tensor L^{-1}|. Additionally, CE failure is a condition on the pair (C, gamma), not on a point of M_{6,6}, so the target of the claimed monomorphism is not well-defined without a stack-level full-faithfulness argument.
invalid_steps.statement: Asserting that the balanced CE failure model maps monomorphically into an evaluation-failure locus in M_{6,6} while disclaiming the identification L ~= omega_C(-D).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The canonical torsor is I -> I^{red-supp} and its reduced form is I_red -> (I^{red-supp})_red; reducing only the source generally destroys flatness over nonreduced bases, so the finite etale torsor property is lost.
invalid_steps.statement: Passing from the ordered configuration model to the unordered divisor model by reducing only the source, i.e. forming I_red -> I^{red-supp}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A connected finite etale cover of a connected locally Noetherian base need not be irreducible; connectedness and irreducibility diverge on non-normal bases, so the [S_6 : H] component formula requires normality or an independent geometric-irreducibility argument.
invalid_steps.statement: Upgrading the count of pi_1^etale-orbits (connected components of the finite etale S_6-cover) to a count of irreducible components without a normality hypothesis on the base.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: That argument computes Aut(C, gamma, Gamma), automorphisms of the tetragonal cover preserving the divisor, whereas the group relevant to M_{6,6} is Aut(C, Gamma). An automorphism of C preserving Gamma need not preserve the pencil, and triviality of the kernel is not formal, since a nontrivial automorphism of a genus-6 curve can fix as many as 2g+2 = 14 points and hence can fix six marked points.
invalid_steps.statement: Proving a stabilizer or inertia clause by observing that an automorphism induces a PGL_2 transformation of P^1 fixing the marked images, and then quoting the clause for the forgetful map to M_{6,6}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The cokernel is globally the pullback of R^1 pi_* L tensored by the convention-dependent tautological line M_univ determined by O(D_univ) = L tensor pi^*M_univ; the fibrewise isomorphism with H^1(L_b) requires a choice of trivialization of the one-dimensional M_univ fibre and does not yield an untwisted Hodge-bundle isomorphism, so excess and Chern-class computations must retain the line twist or prove it trivial.
invalid_steps.statement: Identifying the excess cokernel along the ordered etale incidence over the projective bundle with the pullback of R^1 pi_* L without a twist.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The formula is stratum-dependent; substituting one fixed value of dim(H_k) across all strata contradicts the separately established bound on the deeper stratum's dimension, so the resulting dimension estimates are internally inconsistent.
invalid_steps.statement: Using a single stratum dimension for every stratum in the formula dim(I|_{H_k}) = dim(H_k) + k - 1.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A positive bound on fibre dimension over a stratum is compatible with positive-dimensional fibres there; quasi-finiteness requires zero-dimensional fibres over every point, and stratum-by-stratum statements of mixed strength do not assemble into a global finiteness statement.
invalid_steps.statement: Concluding that a forgetful morphism has finite fibres or is quasi-finite from injectivity over one stratum together with a bound on fibre dimension over another.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Rational irreducibility of the representations of the deck group does not constrain the geometric monodromy of the tetragonal family or the configuration-space coefficients, and a finite pushforward of the constant sheaf may contain non-Tate local systems; rational averaging preserves an already established Tate structure but cannot create one.
invalid_steps.statement: Concluding pure-Tate cohomology of the failure locus from rationality of the irreducible representations of S_6 or from a finite branch morphism of the Hurwitz stack to an open of a moduli of pointed rational curves.

reusable_computations.statement: deg L = deg(W_5 tensor omega_C^{-1}) = 16 - (2g-2) = 16 - 10 = 6 at g=6, hence chi(L) = deg L - g + 1 = 6 - 6 + 1 = 1 and h^0(L) = 1 + h^1(L).
deg(omega_C tensor W_f|_C^vee(Gamma)) = 4f+n-2g-14; at g=6 this is n-10 for f=4 and n-6 for f=5, so at n=6 the values are -4 and 0 respectively, and for n <= 5 both are negative.
deg M = deg(omega_C^2 tensor W_5^vee) = 2(2g-2) - (4g+12-4f)|_{g=6,f=5} = 20 - 16 = 4, with h^0(L) = 1 + h^0(M) and Clifford bound h^0(M) <= deg(M)/2 + 1 = 3.
deg(omega_C^2(-D)) = 2(2g-2) - 4 = 20 - 4 = 16 = deg W_5 at g=6, and a twist by gamma^*A shifts this by 4 deg A, forcing deg A = 0 and A ~= O_{P^1}.

Under the balanced hypothesis with the weak relative-canonical normalization: h^0(O_C(D)) = 2, h^1(L) = h^0(omega_C tensor L^{-1}) = h^0(O_C(D)) = 2, and h^0(L) = 1 + h^1(L) = 3 on every geometric fibre.

Relative dimension bookkeeping over the base: the ordered configuration space of six points has relative dimension 6, the P^2-bundle model and its distinct-support open have relative dimension 2, hence the closed immersion has constant codimension 6 - 2 = 4 with locally free conormal of rank 4, and each component of the ordered cover has dimension dim(S_alpha) + 2.
Fibrewise rank bounds for the filtered balanced evaluation at (g,n) = (6,6) with six pairwise-disjoint sections: rank(phi) in {11,12} and rank(phi_5) in {5,6}, so I_11(phi) = I_5(phi_5) = O_B.

Hyperelliptic degree-four model y^2 = f_14(x), z = x^2: the restriction H^0(Sym^2 E(-6)) -> H^0(6A) is surjective onto the 7-dimensional space of degree-<=6 polynomials in x with kernel H^0(O(1))*(w^2 - z v^2) of dimension exactly 2, forcing relations splitting type (2,7) rather than (4,5).

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Irreducibility of the balanced base of the family, and consequently the number of irreducible components of the ordered evaluation-failure locus, are undetermined; the component correspondence only transports components of the base to components of the incidence and its distinct-support open.

The geometric monodromy image of the finite etale S_6-cover is unknown: neither fullness of S_6, nor the existence of a transposition, nor the occurrence loci are established, and converting connected components of the cover into irreducible components additionally requires normality of the base.

The projective-bundle model, regular immersion, and torsor statements are proved only over a reduced locally Noetherian base; the extension to nonreduced bases (where Grauert fails) and to algebraic stack bases with a smooth atlas is not carried out.
The stabilizer groups Aut(C, Gamma) and Aut(C, gamma, Gamma) are not determined, nor is the relation between them, so moduli inertia and any stack-level full-faithfulness statement remain open.

No morphism from the balanced ordered model to M_{6,6} is constructed, and its faithfulness, quasi-finiteness, closedness, image closure, and absolute codimension are all undetermined; in particular no closed pure-codimension-four embedding, lci, or Gysin statement inside M_{6,6} is available.

The unbalanced CE strata are unconstructed: the evaluation-failure locus off the balanced splitting locus, and any closure point of the balanced locus lying outside it, are not exhibited, so non-closedness of the balanced model and the exhaustiveness of the component/stabilizer/codimension analysis of the full failure locus are not established.

The weak relative-canonical normalization remains an explicit hypothesis rather than a discharged fact; either a cited CE relative-canonical normalization must be added as a source line or every downstream clause must stay conditionalized on it.

Whether a non-primitive degree-four pencil factoring through a positive-genus intermediate curve can have balanced CE splitting is unresolved; only the hyperelliptic-composed case is excluded by the relations-splitting computation.

All Hodge, weight, purity, and Tate consequences remain untreated: no cohomological, motivic, or compactification statement about the exact lowest-weight target follows from the relative geometry, and the pure-Tate statement for the codimension-13 contribution supported on the failure locus is not addressed.
Positive characteristic is untreated: the distinct-support density argument uses characteristic-zero separability and Bertini, and would fail in small positive characteristic.

Descent of any cohomological or weight computation from the ordered model to the unordered one is available only rationally (S_6-invariants equal coinvariants with Q-coefficients); integral-coefficient and coarse-space versions require independent justification.
